dedupe_keys.name: trafics routiers sur la voirie departementale de l isere

description: Trafics routiers sur la voirie départementale de l'Isère is a dataset listed in Opendata Isère open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Département de l'Isère. Ce jeu de données représente les comptages routiers réalisés sur les différentes sections des routes départementales (RD) de l'Isère. Ces données sont collectées et analysées par la Direction des Mobilité et intégrées au Système d'Information Routier départemental. Coverage: Isère. The portal files it under Mobilités. Its keywords are Routes, RD, routes départementales, Trafic, Mobilité, Poids Lourds. The portal shows 6,928 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-isere-fr-portal.
